extras: The plugin makes no network requests and does not record or send typed content.
intentEvidence: Monk Mode hides everything except the note you're writing, and leaves a quiet footer with the few things you still need.
problem: Users are distracted by the numerous UI elements, sidebars, and status bars present in the standard Obsidian interface while trying to focus on writing.
summary: Monk Mode provides a distraction-free writing environment by hiding the Obsidian UI and adding features like typewriter sounds and a no-delete mode.
